simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דִּמְנָה (H1829) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: דִּמְנָה (Dimnâh) means Dimnah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 21 35.

definitions.full: H1829. Dimnah דִּמְנָה proper name, of a location Levitical city in Zebulun Josh 21:35 (but read perhaps רִמֹּנָה +; compare 1Chr 6:62 ; Josh 19:13 , and see Di).
definitions.rootNote: feminine from the same as 1828 ; a dung-heap;
